hunks.baseline: The death scattering away before my eyes.
The warm presence wrapping around my wounded, exhausted body.
hunks.sol: Death falling away from me. A gentle warmth wrapping around my wounded, exhausted body.

hunks.baseline: As clear bell chimes rang out beneath the storm-cloud-filled sky, I slowly closed my eyes.
hunks.sol: Clear bells rang beneath the storm-clouded sky. I slowly closed my eyes.

hunks.baseline: Instead of the unseen moonlight, the demon of sleep poured down over me.
hunks.sol: With no moonlight to be seen, the sleep demon came pouring down instead.

hunks.baseline: It was stronger than any opponent I had ever faced.
hunks.sol: It was stronger than any enemy I had ever faced.
